# Fixture licenses

The grammars and themes in this folder are test fixtures, copied from the
[Shiki](https://shiki.style) bundles (`@shikijs/langs` and `@shikijs/themes` 3.23.0),
which redistribute them from [tm-grammars](https://github.com/shikijs/textmate-grammars-themes).
Each one keeps its original license, listed below.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| grammar | rust | MIT | https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/af600487b1e94374d9f48f57cbf2cad24656b07f/extensions/rust/syntaxes/rust.tmLanguage.json |
